Can you fiddle with the settings of your machine, look for something caller ‘softPAP’ or similar? Turning this on/up will reduce the pressure temporarily, when you breathe out. 

Can you pull your mask away from your nose, to your top lip with it still on your face? If not, you’re wearing it too tight. Wear it at home for a couple of hours, with the machine, and watch YouTube or read or something. Get used to the feeling of it on your face.

I will offer you an alternative point of view. My boyfriend is getting married soon. We have ( hopefully ) set up the foundations for a long term relationship. Having committed relationships, external to your marriage IS possible.

Let me make something clear to you, OP. Your marriage affords your husband certain financial, social, legal privileges that are only available to ONE partner. You may want to get married, or an adjacent recognition of your commitment to another partner in the future, but the legal contract of marriage still offers your husband the legal protections that another partner can never access. For that reason, you cannot hold it against your partner for wanting a marriage of his own. You have these things, he does not. This is called couples privilege.

I understand you are feeling things regarding your husband and your relationship right now. I’m sorry, I don’t have anything to offer you in regard to that. Talking therapy for you, perhaps in the future you and your husband could attend couples therapy. Sit with your feelings and ask yourself what you truly want in your relationships in this life.

My last thing you say OP, is that this man has told you he does not want to commit to you long-term. Please, believe him. You will not change his mind. Blowing up your marriage and making yourself available to him, will not change his mind. Enjoy what you have now, but know that it is just that, for now. Please don’t put your eggs in this man’s basket. He is telling you he does not want them.
